title.value: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE -CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS
title.justification: The title is directly taken from the paper, accurately reflecting its content and focus on an AI-based monkeypox detector.
title.quote: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE -CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development and implementation of AICOM-MP, an AI-based tool designed to detect monkeypox in images from resource-constrained environments, like low-end mobile devices. This tool aims to improve healthcare access in least developed countries by being part of Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs), which are autonomous vehicles equipped with medical diagnostic equipment and AI technology. The AICOM-MP tool achieves state-of-the-art accuracy by using a comprehensive dataset and attention model inspired by medical professionals' diagnostic practices. The research emphasizes making the technology universally accessible, including through offline capabilities.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on enabling healthcare access in least developed countries through the AICOM-MP tool, which is expressly designed for use in resource-constrained environments typical of the Global South.
primary_category.quote: Under the Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) initiative, we are developing, open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

secondary_categories.justification: The paper primarily focuses on healthcare access in resource-constrained environments, which are specific to the Global South, and does not directly relate to other eco-responsible AI categories.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not align with any predefined sub-categories focused on environmental or resource efficiency. Its emphasis is specifically on healthcare delivery in resource-constrained environments, a topic not covered by the existing sub-categories.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no direct secondary subcategories applicable as the paper is centered around healthcare access in the Global South rather than on other eco-responsible AI themes.

applications.value: AI-based monkeypox detection on low-end devices in resource-constrained environments
applications.justification: The paper's primary contribution is the AICOM-MP tool, which detects monkeypox using AI on devices common in resource-limited settings, explicitly aimed at aiding healthcare in the Global South.
applications.quote: Under the AMCs initiative and facing the recent global monkeypox outbreak, in this article we introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector that has achieved SOTA performance and capable of handling images taken from resource-constrained devices.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does fit within the existing category of 'Support to Global South', so there is no need for a new eco-responsible category.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's content does not necessitate a new sub-category as it focuses on AI healthcare solutions for resource-constrained settings under the existing 'Support to Global South' category.
